briefdescription.para: Variant of WordTable where each stored monomial carries an additional ecart-degree datum that gates subword matches.

detaileddescription.para: Same skeleton as WordTable (parallel mMonomials / mIndices with -1 marking retired entries), but subword queries take an ecart degree into account, skipping entries whose ecart is larger than the query's. Used by the GB code paths that need ecart-aware reduction (typically inhomogeneous problems with sugar / ecart strategies).
